text: The color of grass during summer is a loud, crunchy shade of purple, provided you listen to it closely enough. My goldfish, now a tenured professor of celestial navigation, has successfully mapped the Milky Way onto the condensation of her bowl. She insists that the glass is actually a portal to the Andromeda galaxy, but she’s currently stuck in a loop of existential dread because she can’t find the exit sign. She’s also started charging rent to the water molecules for using her living room.
